title: Louis-CFM/coucou
why_read: A lightweight menu-bar companion widget for monitoring Claude Code sessions is a niche novelty tool rather than a significant technical contribution.
analysis: This is a small macOS/Windows utility that displays a cute animated character in the notch or menu bar area to show the status of ongoing Claude Code AI coding sessions. It's essentially a UI convenience layer rather than a deep technical tool, likely just polling session state and rendering a simple animation. The appeal is mostly aesthetic and about ambient awareness of AI agent activity rather than solving a hard engineering problem. Fun for AI coding tool enthusiasts, but low substance for a technical digest.
